name: dsh-guikit-remote
description: DSH GUI Toolkit REMOTE — Windows desktop control when the dsh host runs on another machine. The 13 dsh-guikit tools execute on the remote Windows box through the windows-mcp PowerShell channel (streamable-http MCP), screenshots are fetched over scp, and gui_vision answers questions about the screen using the GPU of the host (the controlled Windows machine) or the server (the machine running dsh).
